visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short grey hair and glasses, wearing a black shirt, stands in a bright, crowded exhibition hall. He speaks energetically towards the camera, gesturing with his hands. Behind him is a large green NVIDIA logo and MGX Ecosystem signage. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of several circular brand logos on a table, including NVIDIA Partner and Met AI. In the background, white booth walls and professional signage are visible. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional convention center. (3) The host stands beside a younger man in a black jacket. They are looking at a computer monitor displaying complex digital twin warehouse diagrams with shelving and paths. The environment is well-lit with various tech displays and blurred passers-by in the distance. (4) A screen capture shows a 3D simulation of a warehouse environment. Brown boxes move along conveyor belts, and a robotic forklift operates between shelves. The lighting in the simulation is flat but detailed, showing textures of the warehouse floor and equipment. (5) The host interviews a man in a black shirt in front of a POD Innovation display. The monitor shows real-time street footage with green and red boxes identifying cars and pedestrians. The man gestures towards the screen while explaining the AI detection system. (6) A 3D rail simulation appears on screen, showing a train approaching a station. A white car is placed on the tracks as a test obstacle, with text overlays identifying 'truck' and 'car' in various colors. The simulation environment includes tracks, station platforms, and lighting. (7) The host stands with a man in a blue suit at the NeuinX booth. The background displays text about AI basketball analysis. Tablets on the table show app interfaces with video clips of basketball players in action on a court. (8) Close-up shots of a smartphone show a basketball game video with a 'Shot Result' overlay. The app interface allows users to select highlights and apply effects like 'Roar' or 'Swag'. The screen is bright, showing a clear user interface and video playback. (9) The host returns to his initial position in front of the NVIDIA sign, looking directly at the camera and speaking with a smile, concluding the segment. His body posture is open and inviting, and the background remains busy with exhibition visitors.
